job.title: Staff Software Engineer – Java/Backend/AI, Dispute Platform
job.pay_full: $133,300 – $213,400 a year (estimated), which may include sales incentives; bonus and equity may also apply

details.about: Visa's global Disputes Platform supports financial institutions in more than 190 countries. As a Staff Software Engineer you'll design and build scalable backend services with Java, distributed systems, microservices, SQL and cloud-native technology, working with engineering, product and business teams and using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools.
duties: Design, build, test and deploy scalable Java applications, APIs, web services and microservices for the Disputes Platform
Build highly available distributed systems for large transaction volumes
Turn business requirements into technical designs
Write clean, reusable code, review code and mentor teammates
Find the root causes of production issues and fix them for good
Use SQL and databases for transaction processing and analysis
Take part in Agile planning, design reviews, releases and incident response
Drive modernisation, automation and observability, using AI-assisted development tools
needs: 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's, 2+ years with an advanced degree, a PhD, or 8+ years of relevant experience
Strong experience building highly scalable, distributed, enterprise-grade applications
Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, React and REST/SOAP web services
nice: 7+ years with a Bachelor's (or 5+ with an advanced degree, 3+ with a PhD)
Strong SQL; NoSQL experience; DB2, Cassandra and MySQL preferred
Kafka, Gradle, Git; Spark and ETL frameworks
Generative AI for development; AI/ML experience
Jenkins, Ansible or Chef; Selenium, TestNG, Cucumber; Python and Linux
details.benefits: Estimated salary $133,300 – $213,400 a year, which may include sales incentives; the role may also be eligible for bonus and equity. Benefits can include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: At least 3 days a week in the office
Visa says this role does not offer visa sponsorship or transfer
